newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco, France to cooperate on drug issues.
newsitem.headline: Morocco, France to cooperate on drug issues.

text.p: Visiting French Justice Minister Jacques Toubon on Friday discussed with Moroccan officials ways to develop cooperation to fight drug trafficking, the official MAP news agency said.

Toubon met Interior Minister Driss Basri in Rabat "to examine cooperation between France and Morocco and the means to hold joint action against cannabis cultivation in the northern province of the Rif," the agency said.

After several accusations of being one of the major cannabis exporters to Europe, Morocco called on the European Community for technical and financial aid to eradicate hashish cultivation in the five-million populated northern provinces.
Morocco said it expects to invest up to $2.0 billion in the area to set up small and medium agricultural projects to take the place of drug cultivation.
France is the main Western commercial partner of Morocco. An estimated 800,000 Moroccans live in France.
